  <text x="20" y="275" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Content advisory for parents and guardians</text>
  <rect x="20" y="288" width="350" height="1" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <text x="20" y="314" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Content advisory</text>

  <text x="332" y="313" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">3 ratings</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="337" width="348" height="82" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="20" y="335" width="348" height="82" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="76" y="399" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Review details before viewing</text>

    <rect x="284" y="437" width="67" height="24" rx="12" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="317" y="453" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Severe</text>
    <text x="76" y="472" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Graphic violence, battles and gore</text>
    <text x="76" y="491" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Includes intense scenes involving death</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profanity card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="521" width="348" height="82" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="20" y="519" width="348" height="82" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="76" y="583" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Language varies across episodes</text>

  <!-- Spoiler warning -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="621" width="350" height="88" rx="8" fill="#F5C4181A"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="647" r="12" fill="#F5C418"/>

    <circle cx="47" cy="655" r="1.5" fill="#333333"/>
    <text x="70" y="649" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Spoiler warning</text>

  <g>
    <polygon points="39,797 49,789 59,797 59,808 51,808 51,801 47,801 47,808 39,808" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="49" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#F5C418">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="137" cy="797" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="143" y1="803" x2="149" y2="809" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="137" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <polyline points="220,794 224,791 228,794 233,791 237,794 237,805 220,805 220,794" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="228" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>

  <g>
